house.description: Federal deduction for qualified overtime compensation adopted.

House.text: Introduction and first reading, referred to Taxes

bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to taxation; individual income; adopting the federal deduction for qualified overtime compensation; amending Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 290.0132, by adding a subdivision.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 290.0132, is amended by adding a subdivision to read:

[+Subd. 40.+]

[+Overtime income.+]

[+(a) The amount of qualified overtime compensation allowed as a deduction under section 225 of the Internal Revenue Code is a subtraction. +]

[+(b) Notwithstanding section 225, paragraph (g), of the Internal Revenue Code, the subtraction under this subdivision is allowed for taxable years beginning after December 31, 2028. +]

[+EFFECTIVE DATE.+]

[+This section is effective retroactively for taxable years beginning after December 31, 2024. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to taxation; individual income; adopting the federal deduction for qualified overtime compensation; amending Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 290.0132, by adding a subdivision.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 290.0132, is amended by adding a subdivision to read:

Subd. 40.

Overtime income.

(a) The amount of qualified overtime compensation allowed as a deduction under section 225 of the Internal Revenue Code is a subtraction.

(b) Notwithstanding section 225, paragraph (g), of the Internal Revenue Code, the subtraction under this subdivision is allowed for taxable years beginning after December 31, 2028.

EFFECTIVE DATE.

This section is effective retroactively for taxable years beginning after December 31, 2024.
additions: (a) The amount of qualified overtime compensation allowed as a deduction under section 225 of the Internal Revenue Code is a subtraction.
(b) Notwithstanding section 225, paragraph (g), of the Internal Revenue Code, the subtraction under this subdivision is allowed for taxable years beginning after December 31, 2028.
This section is effective retroactively for taxable years beginning after December 31, 2024.
